models.name: WeatherNext Cyclones (WN-C)
models.architecture: Functional Generative Networks (FGN); 28×28km res; 1,000-member ensemble; 15-day horizon
models._note: Operational tropical-cyclone forecasting (track/intensity/size). Trained on ~20TB global analysis + IBTrACS (~5,000 storms). ~1 day lead-time advantage over leading operational models (Nature). Open-sourced.

models.name: WeatherNext 2-mini
models.architecture: Compact WeatherNext 2; 111×111km res; runs on a single TPU
models._note: Compact global weather model; free public Colab. Coarser-resolution variant with strong performance.

models.name: Lyria 3.5
models.architecture: Latent diffusion over temporal audio latents
models._note: Music generation (high-quality audio). Eval via qualitative human+automated framework (no numeric table in card).
